material.acceptance_criteria: Case-insensitive grep of remote main tree for starcraft, sc2, blizzard, galaxy (excluding LICENSES inventory and third-party attribution lines) returns zero hits. Every CI job passes on the final sha. A CI job prints: naming comments ok starcraft=0 sc2=0 blizzard=0
material.description: Scope (orchestrator decision, remote main only): every case-insensitive hit for starcraft, sc2, blizzard, galaxy in comments, docs and README text becomes a generic description of the thing. Keep third-party attributions (StormLib, MIT) verbatim. The mpq format name is renamed to archive only where it names the engine's own archive reader in identifiers and docs; do not move crate directories. Do not change minerals, vespene, supply or the .star extension identifiers. LICENSES inventory file excluded. Publish via Git API from remote main, one commit per area (docs; rust comments; js and scripts comments), PATCH without force, commit identity lanmower, no trailers.
material.resolution: No remote-main hits outside the license inventory; naming comments CI step green on the tip.
material.subject: Reword StarCraft, SC2, Blizzard and Galaxy mentions in comments, docs and README text to generic descriptions
